name: Nanogene Conversion
oracle_text: Choose target creature you control. Each other creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it isn't legendary.
blocked_sentences: Choose target creature you control. Each other creature becomes a copy of that creature until end of turn, except it isn't legendary.

needs.what: a `remove_supertypes` key in `become_copy`'s `except_` (707.9b "except it isn't legendary"), written into the in-place copy's `copying_remove_supertypes` so every creature that becomes a copy of a legendary target drops Legendary and the legend rule does not wipe them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `become_copy` handles the in-place, until-end-of-turn copy of a target onto `count: all` other creatures (exclude_binding t1), but its `except_` accepts only add_keywords, keep_abilities, add_types and add_supertypes (BECOME_COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS) and the op explicitly resets `copying_remove_supertypes` to None. `remove_supertypes` exists only on `copy_permanent` / as-enters copies (Spark Double), which create a new object rather than altering existing ones. Without the exception, copying a legendary creature makes every copy legendary and the legend rule kills all but one.
